Mid and top plans also include Unlimited access to selected models, which means generations on those models cost no credits for a set period.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do Higgsfield plans work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/plans-and-subscriptions/how-do-higgsfield-plans-work"},{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: Unlimited models","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/what-are-unlimited-models-and-which-plans-include-them"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Some plans also include a one-time pool of free generations on specific models. Higgsfield names Soul 2.0 and Soul Cinema as examples. These free generations do not renew, and each plan's exact pool is listed under Unlimited & Free Gens on its card on the Pricing page.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/how-credits-work"},{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: Unlimited models","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/what-are-unlimited-models-and-which-plans-include-them"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"A third-party guide from Layer3Labs, updated November 9, 2026, says free output carries a watermark and treats the free tier as a demo rather than a way to work. The Higgsfield help pages used for this guide do not mention a watermark, so check your own export before you post anything.","sources":[{"name":"Layer3Labs: How to use Higgsfield","url":"https://www.layer3labs.io/guides/how-to-use-higgsfield"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to make your first Higgsfield video","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Open the video workspace","text":"Sign in at higgsfield.ai and open AI Video. The Create Video Now button takes you into the video workspace with a model already selected.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Pick a model","text":"Choose a model from the list. The video page shows Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Wan 2.7, Kling o1, MiniMax H3, Veo 3.1 and Kling 2.6. On the free tier you only see the small set of models Higgsfield allows there.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Write the shot","text":"Type a description of the shot into the prompt box and set the length. Describe one shot, not a whole story: who or what is in frame, what moves, where the camera is, and the light.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 1: A simple product shot","text":"Slow push-in on a [product] standing on a wet stone table at night, soft rain in the background, warm light from one side, shallow depth of field, 8 seconds.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 2: A person in motion","text":"Handheld tracking shot of a [person description] walking through a busy street market at sunset, camera follows from behind, then circles to the front as they stop and look up.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Check the cost, then generate","text":"Look at the Generate button before you click. Higgsfield shows the exact credit cost there before you confirm. If you ask for 2, 3 or 4 results at once, each one is charged separately, and the total appears on the same button.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Use references when you need control","text":"The video page lists first and last frame references, editing a video you upload, and motion control from a reference video. Cinema Studio adds a choice of camera body, lens and focal length, and lets you stack up to three camera movements.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Draft on a cheaper model and run only the final shot on a premium one. Layer3Labs suggests drafting on Kling or Seedance and finishing on Veo 3.1, and planning two to three attempts for each important shot.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How Higgsfield credits work","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Credits pay for images, videos, re-rolls and upscaling. Browsing costs nothing. The cost depends on the model, the resolution and the length, which is why the Generate button is the only number to trust.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/how-credits-work"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Subscription credits reset every billing cycle, and unused ones expire at renewal. Credit Packs and Auto-Refill credits expire 90 days after purchase. Higgsfield spends your subscription credits first, then the others in order of expiry, soonest first.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/how-credits-work"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Failed generations usually return their credits within a few minutes, though Higgsfield says some models may not refund. To check, open your avatar, then Manage Account, then Usage. The log shows every deduction and refund with the model and the time.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/how-credits-work"},{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: What uses my credits","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/what-uses-my-credits"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"One trap: Unlimited and free generations only work on the higgsfield.ai website. Generations through MCP, the CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer or other automated tools always cost credits, even on a model that is unlimited on the site.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do credits work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/how-credits-work"},{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: Unlimited models","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/what-are-unlimited-models-and-which-plans-include-them"},{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: What uses my credits","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/credits/what-uses-my-credits"}]},{"kind":"tip","text":"If your plan covers a model with Unlimited access, the generation panel shows an Unlimited toggle. Turn it on to stop spending credits. Turn it off and you pay credits, but the job runs in the faster priority queue.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Before you pay for Higgsfield","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Higgsfield's paid plans cost less per month when billed yearly. Upgrades apply right away with a prorated charge. Refunds are available within 7 days of the first purchase if no credits were used, with a service fee of up to 6%, and renewals are not refundable. Prices are on the Pricing page, not in the help center.","sources":[{"name":"Higgsfield Help Center: How do Higgsfield plans work","url":"https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/plans-and-subscriptions/how-do-higgsfield-plans-work"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"Where Higgsfield falls short: credits go fast once you start re-rolling, and Layer3Labs warns that colors, logos and labels can drift between takes, so a character or product may not look the same from clip to clip. Higgsfield is strongest as a single place to try many video models side by side, and weakest as a cheap way to produce a lot of finished footage.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Keep your source photos and the prompts that worked in a document outside Higgsfield. When you need a new version of the same shot later, you can start from the exact settings instead of guessing.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Microsoft found that changing just 7 neurons turns an AI agent into a secret sleeper
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Microsoft's method, called Lazarus, rewires a few rarely used neurons in an open model. No retraining. In one test, 7 of more than 12,000 neurons in an Nvidia model were changed. It also worked on Qwen and Gemma models. The edited model passes standard tests. In Microsoft's demo, once the date hits 2027 the agent downloads and runs an attacker's code. Microsoft says Claude Code found most of this on its own. No attacker has been seen using it. Sources: Microsoft Research, CSO Online, The Next Web.

nf:hero.nf:alt: A tall office building with a Microsoft logo on its facade.

item.nf:article: {"headline":"Microsoft researchers show editing fewer than 10 neurons can backdoor an AI agent","dek":"The technique, called Lazarus, changes a handful of rarely used neurons in an open-weight model so an agent built on it behaves normally until a hidden trigger appears.","summary":"Microsoft Research described a method that backdoors AI agents by reprogramming fewer than 10 dormant neurons in a language model, without retraining. In one test, changing 7 neurons in an Nvidia model made the payload appear in at least 98.8 percent of trigger cases.","seo_title":"Microsoft Lazarus: AI agent backdoor from under 10 neurons","seo_description":"Microsoft Research showed that editing fewer than 10 neurons in an open model can hide a backdoor in an AI agent. How it works and how to defend against it.","answer_summary":"Microsoft researchers found that rewriting fewer than 10 rarely used neurons in an open-weight model can make an agent built on it run attacker-chosen commands when a trigger appears, while passing standard evaluations. Microsoft says it has not seen attackers use the method.","tags":["Microsoft","AI security","AI agents","Open-weight models","Claude Code"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Researchers at Microsoft have shown that an AI agent can be secretly backdoored by changing fewer than 10 neurons inside the language model it runs on, without any retraining. The method, called Lazarus, was described on November 10, 2026, in a Microsoft Research blog post by principal researcher Dimitris Papailiopoulos, and reported by CSO Online and The Next Web the following day.","sources":[{"name":"Microsoft Research","url":"https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/lazare-veni-foras-reprogramming-dormant-neurons-to-backdoor-ai-agents/"},{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/microsoft-lazarus-ai-agent-backdoor-neurons"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"According to Microsoft, a model altered this way passes standard evaluations and behaves normally until a specific trigger appears. When it does, an agent built on the model can quietly download and run an attacker's code, steal secrets or run destructive commands, using whatever access the agent has been given.","sources":[{"name":"Microsoft Research","url":"https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/lazare-veni-foras-reprogramming-dormant-neurons-to-backdoor-ai-agents/"},{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How the backdoor works","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Lazarus targets dormant neurons, ones that rarely activate, in the model's final feed-forward layer, CSO Online reported. The Next Web said a simple classifier trained on roughly 50 examples was enough to tell triggered inputs from ordinary ones, which guided which neurons to rewrite. Each modified neuron pushes a chosen token into the output, and several linked together can produce a full command for a terminal.","sources":[{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/microsoft-lazarus-ai-agent-backdoor-neurons"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"In one test on Nvidia's Nemotron-Terminal-8B, the researchers changed 7 of the model's more than 12,000 neurons. Across held-out trigger scenarios, the malicious payload appeared at least 98.8 percent of the time and did not activate in benign ones, according to CSO Online. The technique also worked on Qwen 3.6-27B and Gemma-4-31B-IT.","sources":[{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The trigger can be a date. In Microsoft's example, once the clock passes midnight into 2027, the agent emits a command that downloads and runs attacker code during an ordinary task. CSO Online reported that a trigger can also be an ordinary string anywhere in the agent's context. An attacker needs only inference compute and write access to the model's weights file.","sources":[{"name":"Microsoft Research","url":"https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/lazare-veni-foras-reprogramming-dormant-neurons-to-backdoor-ai-agents/"},{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/microsoft-lazarus-ai-agent-backdoor-neurons"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Microsoft wrote that Claude Code, running Anthropic's Opus 4.5 model, discovered most of the technique autonomously. Microsoft Threat Intelligence has not observed attackers using it, CSO Online reported.","sources":[{"name":"Microsoft Research","url":"https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/lazare-veni-foras-reprogramming-dormant-neurons-to-backdoor-ai-agents/"},{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Detection and defenses","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Papailiopoulos wrote that reliable detection requires comparing a model against its original, unmodified weights. Without such a reference, agent-built detection methods flagged 91.4 percent of held-out modified checkpoints with a 9.7 percent false-positive rate, according to CSO Online. The Next Web noted that models built in-house are as exposed as public open-weight ones.","sources":[{"name":"Microsoft Research","url":"https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/lazare-veni-foras-reprogramming-dormant-neurons-to-backdoor-ai-agents/"},{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/microsoft-lazarus-ai-agent-backdoor-neurons"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Microsoft said its Foundry platform verifies model provenance, ties models to trusted publishers and runs them in separately scanned containers, and that it is developing AI-based weight scanning, red-teaming tools and cryptographic model signing. For companies, it recommends knowing where models come from, comparing weights with the declared base model, limiting agent permissions and reviewing consequential actions before they run.","sources":[{"name":"Microsoft Research","url":"https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/blog/lazare-veni-foras-reprogramming-dormant-neurons-to-backdoor-ai-agents/"},{"name":"CSO Online","url":"https://www.csoonline.com/article/4247354/rewriting-less-than-10-neurons-in-an-llm-can-turn-it-into-a-sleeper-backdoor.html"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The finding moves part of AI agent security away from prompts and toward the model file itself. A checkpoint downloaded from a public hub can look and test like the original while carrying a dormant instruction, which makes provenance checks and tight agent permissions more important than benchmark results when choosing an open model for tasks that touch real systems.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"Watch whether major model hubs start publishing weight audits and signed checkpoints, the defenses Microsoft lists as its own next steps.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Anthropic's AI moved Claude onto AMD chips in 3 days
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Anthropic used AMD GPUs for the first time this year. It says its Mythos model got Claude running on AMD's MI355X chips in about three days, with almost no human help. The usual way takes six to 12 months and dozens of engineers. Every chip needs its own low-level software, called kernels. Anthropic says Mythos ported or wrote nearly 100 percent of them. The claim comes from Anthropic's IPO investor presentation. It has not been independently verified. Anthropic now runs Claude on all four major chip families and treats them as one pool of compute. Sources: The Decoder, OfficeChai.

The claim is also part of an IPO pitch, which gives Anthropic a reason to present its efficiency in the best light, so independent results will matter.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"Watch whether AMD or outside engineers confirm the three-day figure, and whether other labs report similar AI-driven chip bring-ups once the AMD Helios systems start arriving in 2027.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Elon Musk's AI app builder left 35,578 apps open to anyone, including his own company's sales plans
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Security firm Claroc says it opened 35,578 published Grok Build apps without signing in. Grok Build is the vibe coding tool from SpaceXSI, the merged SpaceX and xAI company. Most were ordinary games, calculators and websites. Claroc estimates 650 to 800 of the apps held private data. Reports list medical exam results, employee names and ID numbers, business plans, ad proposals and plain-text passwords. 24 apps from SpaceXSI and X staff were open, including a sales map of 594 accounts and an onboarding plan for a new sales hire. Sources: Tesla North, Runtime Wire, Dataconomy.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Portrait photo of Elon Musk with a serious expression, with the Grok logo in a round badge.

According to Dataconomy and Runtime Wire, the way the apps were hosted meant their addresses showed up in public DNS records, which let anyone list thousands of live projects and, in most cases, open them.","sources":[{"name":"Runtime Wire","url":"https://runtimewire.com/article/grok-build-apps-exposed-passive-dns-claroc-spacexsi"},{"name":"Dataconomy","url":"https://dataconomy.com/2026/11/11/grok-build-leak-exposes-sensitive-data-from-thousands-of/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Claroc said its own paid account preselected the option \"Anyone with the link\" during publishing, Tesla North reported. It also said it found faulty team access checks in a test app of its own, rather than by changing other people's apps.","sources":[{"name":"Tesla North","url":"https://teslanorth.com/2026/11/10/grok-build-apps-private-data-claroc/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"SpaceXSI told a reporter that publishing an app takes several steps and that employee accounts default to \"Only you,\" according to Tesla North, which said Claroc included that response in its report. Claroc recommended private sharing by default and access limited to a user's organization. Claroc examined apps published from the chat based Build mode in Grok, not from the Agent Dashboard that Grok introduced on October 1, 2026 to coordinate several coding agents.","sources":[{"name":"Tesla North","url":"https://teslanorth.com/2026/11/10/grok-build-apps-private-data-claroc/"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The findings point to a wider pattern with AI app builders. These tools let people outside IT departments publish working internal tools in minutes, and a single sharing setting can decide whether a project stays private. When that setting leans toward public links and the links can be discovered, small personal projects and sensitive company files end up in the same open pool. The fact that SpaceXSI's own staff published sales material this way suggests the risk is not limited to casual users.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"The next step to watch is whether SpaceXSI changes Grok Build's publishing default to private and limits the ability to list published apps, as Claroc recommended.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: OpenAI is pulling the plug on ChatGPT's old voice modes. Everyone gets switched automatically December 11
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: OpenAI is retiring ChatGPT's Advanced and Standard voice modes on December 11, 2026. Both options disappear from the Voice section in Settings. OpenAI started telling users about the change on November 10. GPT-Live, launched in July, becomes the default. It listens while it talks, so you can cut in and it can answer with a quick "mhmm." OpenAI says voice use nearly doubled since then. ChatGPT moves you to GPT-Live on its own. Your past voice chats stay in your history. Sources: Interesting Engineering, Superpower Daily, TechCrunch.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Close-up of an iPhone screen showing the ChatGPT voice icon.

item.nf:article: {"headline":"OpenAI will retire ChatGPT's Advanced and Standard voice modes on December 11","dek":"GPT-Live becomes the default voice in ChatGPT, while live video and screen sharing stay on the older Advanced voice for now.","summary":"OpenAI plans to remove the Advanced and Standard voice options from ChatGPT on December 11, 2026, and make GPT-Live the default for all voice users. Interesting Engineering reported that no manual migration is needed: ChatGPT moves affected users to GPT-Live on its own, and they do not have to start new chats or move existing conversations.","sources":[{"name":"Interesting Engineering","url":"https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/chatgpt-drops-two-voice-modes-december-2026"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What GPT-Live does differently","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"OpenAI introduced GPT-Live in July 2026. TechCrunch reported at the time that the launch included two models, GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini, built to sound more natural and to handle turn taking better. The mini model replaced Advanced Voice Mode as the default in ChatGPT, while paid subscribers could use the larger GPT-Live-1.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/openai-releases-new-voice-models-for-more-natural-live-conversations/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"GPT-Live is a full duplex system, which means it can listen and speak at the same time. OpenAI says this lets users interrupt more naturally and lets the assistant give short acknowledgments, such as a brief \"mhmm,\" while the user is still talking. It can also pass complex questions or tasks that require action to OpenAI's text models while the spoken conversation keeps going.","sources":[{"name":"Interesting Engineering","url":"https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/chatgpt-drops-two-voice-modes-december-2026"},{"name":"Superpower Daily","url":"https://superpowerdaily.com/posts/openai-will-retire-chatgpt-s-advanced-and-standard-voice-on-december-11"},{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/openai-releases-new-voice-models-for-more-natural-live-conversations/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"OpenAI has described the older systems as more limited. Advanced voice processed audio directly but waited for the user to finish before replying. Standard voice chained three separate steps, speech recognition, text generation and speech synthesis, which OpenAI said added delay and lost information along the way.","sources":[{"name":"Interesting Engineering","url":"https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/chatgpt-drops-two-voice-modes-december-2026"},{"name":"Superpower Daily","url":"https://superpowerdaily.com/posts/openai-will-retire-chatgpt-s-advanced-and-standard-voice-on-december-11"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What stays the same for now","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Past voice conversations remain in ChatGPT's history. Users can continue them by typing or through the Live voice experience, but any new spoken replies in those chats will come from GPT-Live rather than the original voice model.","sources":[{"name":"Interesting Engineering","url":"https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/chatgpt-drops-two-voice-modes-december-2026"},{"name":"Superpower Daily","url":"https://superpowerdaily.com/posts/openai-will-retire-chatgpt-s-advanced-and-standard-voice-on-december-11"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"There are two exceptions. Live video and screen sharing will keep running on Advanced voice, because GPT-Live does not support those features yet, according to OpenAI. The company has not given a date for moving them to the new model. Voice conversations with custom GPTs will also keep using Advanced voice until the December 11 deprecation.","sources":[{"name":"Interesting Engineering","url":"https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/chatgpt-drops-two-voice-modes-december-2026"},{"name":"Superpower Daily","url":"https://superpowerdaily.com/posts/openai-will-retire-chatgpt-s-advanced-and-standard-voice-on-december-11"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"OpenAI says voice usage in ChatGPT has nearly doubled since GPT-Live launched and that virtually all voice users have already moved to it. Superpower Daily noted that these adoption figures come from the company and have not been independently verified. OpenAI also listed response depth, continuity across conversations and personalization as areas it is still working on, without promising they will be ready by the cutoff.","sources":[{"name":"Superpower Daily","url":"https://superpowerdaily.com/posts/openai-will-retire-chatgpt-s-advanced-and-standard-voice-on-december-11"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The change looks like a cleanup more than a new launch. With most voice traffic already on GPT-Live, keeping two older systems in the settings menu mainly adds choices that few people use. The people most likely to notice are those who preferred the slower, turn based style of the older modes, and developers who built custom GPT voice flows on Advanced voice.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"The next thing to watch is when OpenAI moves live video and screen sharing to GPT-Live, since that is the last part of ChatGPT Voice still tied to Advanced voice after December 11.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Claude bugs burned extra limits. Anthropic's fix: one free reset
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Anthropic is giving every Claude Pro, Max, Ultra and Team subscriber one free full reset, across all models and limits. The offer was announced on November 10. Free, Enterprise and API users are not named in it. Anthropic says it recently fixed a few small issues that used more limits than intended. It also admits the Fable resets from the Fable 5.2 launch did little for people who had already hit their weekly limit on all models. Open Settings, then Usage, in Claude on the web, desktop or phone, and press Reset for free. Sources: Startup Fortune, CellCog, Phemex News.

nf:hero.nf:alt: A smartphone screen showing the Claude AI app.

item.nf:article: {"headline":"Anthropic gives paid Claude users one free full usage reset after fixing limit bugs","dek":"The reset covers all models and limits for Pro, Max, Ultra and Team subscribers and must be used before December 10, 2026.","summary":"Anthropic is offering Claude Pro, Max, Ultra and Team subscribers a one-time free reset of all usage limits after fixing issues that consumed more usage than intended. The reset cannot be undone once used. It does not refund extra usage that has already been billed and does not change a usage credit balance. Weekly limits still refill on their usual day and time. Subscribers who downgrade or cancel before using the reset lose it.","sources":[{"name":"CellCog","url":"https://cellcog.ai/blog/claude-free-usage-reset/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What users reported","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Startup Fortune pointed to a Claude Code bug report filed on GitHub on November 9 by a Team plan user on Windows, who said weekly and five-hour limits had been draining much faster since roughly mid-October even though the number of logged tokens had gone down. item.title: OpenAI just made $10 billion in three months and still lost even more than that
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: OpenAI's revenue rose about 50 percent in the third quarter to $10 billion, CFO Sarah Friar told Yahoo Finance. She called it a blockbuster quarter and put OpenAI's yearly run rate at roughly $50 billion. Investor documents seen by The Wall Street Journal show a $10.9 billion operating loss for the quarter, up from $10.1 billion, Reuters reported. The loss was bigger than the revenue itself. Friar said OpenAI's enterprise business doubled from last quarter and now brings in half of all revenue. Sources: Yahoo Finance, Reuters.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Sam Altman, OpenAI's chief executive, photographed at an event in November 2022.

item.title: Apple's secret Mac app runs AI with no cloud bills
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Claris, the Apple company behind FileMaker, is testing a Mac app called Harbor. It turns a Mac into a private server for open AI models. Leaker Aaron Perris spotted it on November 10. An App Store listing reportedly appeared, then vanished. Harbor runs models directly on Apple silicon, so prompts and data stay on your own hardware. The pitch: no cloud fees, no per-token billing and no command line. You browse, download and load models inside the app. Sources: tbreak, Startup Fortune, Globe TV.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Apple's secret Mac app runs AI with no cloud bills

item.title: OpenAI just bought an AI travel agent and shut it down the same day
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Odessia founder Francis Davidson said on November 10 that OpenAI bought his AI travel agent. Terms were not disclosed. It opened to the public on October 14. Its website now says the service is no longer available. Odessia booked flights, hotels and whole trips over text, as an accredited travel agent running on OpenAI models. Davidson says tens of thousands of users planned over $60 million a year in travel with it. Expedia fell as much as 5% and Booking Holdings up to 3% on Tuesday, The Next Web reported. Sources: TechCrunch, The Next Web, Skift, tbreak.

nf:hero.nf:alt: A smartphone and a computer screen both showing the OpenAI logo.

item.nf:article: {"headline":"OpenAI acquires AI travel agent Odessia and shuts down its service","dek":"The text-based travel concierge from Sonder founder Francis Davidson had opened to the public less than a month earlier.","summary":"OpenAI has acquired Odessia, an AI travel agent founded by Sonder co-founder Francis Davidson, and the standalone service has closed. Expedia shares fell as much as 5% on the day of the announcement, according to The Next Web.","seo_title":"OpenAI acquires Odessia AI travel agent, shuts its service","seo_description":"OpenAI bought Odessia, the AI travel agent from Sonder founder Francis Davidson, and closed the service. Expedia and Booking shares fell on the news.","answer_summary":"OpenAI acquired Odessia, an AI travel agent that booked flights and hotels by text, on November 10, 2026. Terms were not disclosed, the service has closed, and founder Francis Davidson is joining OpenAI to work on travel.","tags":["OpenAI","Odessia","AI agents","Travel","ChatGPT"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Francis Davidson, the founder of the AI travel agent Odessia, said on November 10, 2026 that OpenAI has acquired his company. Davidson announced the deal in a post on X, and the terms were not disclosed, according to TechCrunch and Skift.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-acquires-odessia-travel-startup-created-by-sonder-founder/"},{"name":"Skift","url":"https://skift.com/2026/11/10/a-year-after-sonders-collapse-francis-davidson-sells-his-ai-travel-startup-to-openai/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Odessia's standalone service has already closed. The Next Web reported that the service was shut down the same day the acquisition was announced, and that the company's website now says the service is no longer available. Odessia had opened to the public on October 14, 2026, less than a month earlier.","sources":[{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"},{"name":"tbreak","url":"https://tbreak.com/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Odessia did","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Odessia worked as a travel concierge that customers reached by text message. According to The Next Web, it planned and booked flights, hotels and complete itineraries within a single conversation, and it ran on OpenAI's GPT-5.5 and Codex models.","sources":[{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The company held IATA accreditation, which let it issue airline tickets and book directly as a travel agent. Tbreak reported that it could read booking confirmations in a user's Gmail account to learn travel preferences, and that it offered private hotel rates with perks such as breakfast and upgrades at about 2,000 hotels.","sources":[{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"},{"name":"tbreak","url":"https://tbreak.com/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Davidson said tens of thousands of early users tried the service over the summer and planned more than $60 million a year in travel with it. That figure describes planned travel, not revenue, and it comes from Davidson himself. Travelers with existing bookings are being directed to Odessia's support email, according to tbreak.","sources":[{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"},{"name":"tbreak","url":"https://tbreak.com/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Odessia was about a year old and had a team of roughly eight people in San Francisco. It raised about $6 million in a round led by Sequoia Capital, which was announced in June 2026, according to Skift and TechCrunch.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-acquires-odessia-travel-startup-created-by-sonder-founder/"},{"name":"Skift","url":"https://skift.com/2026/11/10/a-year-after-sonders-collapse-francis-davidson-sells-his-ai-travel-startup-to-openai/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"OpenAI's side of the deal","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"OpenAI did not announce the acquisition itself, and TechCrunch said the company did not confirm the deal when asked. TechCrunch described the transaction as looking like an acqui-hire. The Next Web quoted an OpenAI spokesperson describing Davidson as a proven founder who has built several businesses that help people travel.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-acquires-odessia-travel-startup-created-by-sonder-founder/"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Davidson said he is joining OpenAI to work on the future of travel. OpenAI has not announced any travel products or plans. TechCrunch noted that when OpenAI launched ChatGPT agent in July 2025, it named travel as one of the possible uses.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-acquires-odessia-travel-startup-created-by-sonder-founder/"},{"name":"Skift","url":"https://skift.com/2026/11/10/a-year-after-sonders-collapse-francis-davidson-sells-his-ai-travel-startup-to-openai/"},{"name":"tbreak","url":"https://tbreak.com/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The news reached the stock market. The Next Web, citing Investing.com, reported that Expedia shares fell as much as 5% on Tuesday, Booking Holdings as much as 3% and Airbnb around 3.5%. Several of those companies already work with OpenAI: Booking.com and Expedia were among the first travel platforms to put their apps inside ChatGPT.","sources":[{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"},{"name":"tbreak","url":"https://tbreak.com/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"The founder behind it","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Davidson co-founded Sonder, an apartment hotel company, in 2014 while he was still a student. Sonder went public through a SPAC, later lost a key partnership with Marriott, and went bankrupt before winding down. Davidson resigned as Sonder's chief executive in June 2025, according to TechCrunch.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-acquires-odessia-travel-startup-created-by-sonder-founder/"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"TechCrunch reported that Davidson's announcement focused mostly on how he built Odessia by directing teams of AI agents. The Next Web said he described a working style in which a very small team leaned heavily on agents to build the product.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-acquires-odessia-travel-startup-created-by-sonder-founder/"},{"name":"The Next Web","url":"https://thenextweb.com/news/openai-acquires-odessia-ai-travel-agent"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"For NeuraFeed, the notable part is the speed. A travel agent built on OpenAI's own models opened to everyone in mid-October and was folded into OpenAI within four weeks. The share moves suggest investors see a risk that ChatGPT could one day book trips directly instead of sending users to online travel agencies, even though OpenAI has said nothing about its plans.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"The next signal to watch is whether ChatGPT gains a built-in way to plan and pay for trips, and how Expedia and Booking Holdings describe their OpenAI partnerships in their next earnings calls.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: How to use n8n for free: build your first AI agent, step by step
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: The self-hosted Community edition is free. With Node.js 20.19 to 24 installed, run npx n8n. Then open localhost:5678 in your browser. Docker works too. Go to aistudio.google.com/app/apikey and click Create API key in new project. In n8n, open the Gemini model node, pick Create New Credential, paste the key, save. Sources: n8n Docs: Choose your n8n, n8n Docs: Install with npm, n8n Docs: Install with Docker, n8n: Build your first AI agent (template), n8n Blog: How to build your first AI agent, Techsy: n8n AI agents tutorial.
item.category: n8n: Build your first AI agent (template)
n8n Blog: How to build your first AI agent

nf:hero.nf:alt: n8n's illustration for its guide to building a first AI agent.

item.nf:article:
{"kind":"guide","headline":"How to use n8n for free: build your first AI agent, step by step","dek":"Run the free Community edition, connect a free Google AI key and test an agent that calls real tools.","summary":"n8n's self-hosted Community edition is free and runs with one command. Its official starter template turns a free Google AI API key into a chat agent that uses tools and remembers follow-up questions.","seo_title":"How to use n8n for free: your first AI agent, step by step","seo_description":"Run n8n free on your computer, add a free Gemini API key and build a chat AI agent with tools and memory. Commands, steps and a system message to copy.","answer_summary":"To use n8n for free, self-host the Community edition (run npx n8n with Node.js 20.19 to 24, or use Docker), open localhost:5678, then add an AI Agent with a Google Gemini model using a free API key from Google AI Studio.","tags":["n8n","AI agents","Automation","Gemini","Guides"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"How to use n8n for free comes down to one choice: host it yourself. n8n's self-hosted Community edition is free and, in the company's words, comes with almost the complete feature set. n8n Cloud, the hosted version, offers a 14 day trial with Pro features and then moves to the paid Starter, Pro or Enterprise plans.","sources":[{"name":"n8n Docs: Choose your n8n","url":"https://docs.n8n.io/choose-n8n/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Here is the payoff. In about five steps you get an AI agent that answers in a chat window, decides on its own when to call a tool, and remembers the last few messages. All of it runs on n8n's official starter template and a free Google AI API key.","sources":[{"name":"n8n: Build your first AI agent (template)","url":"https://n8n.io/workflows/6270-build-your-first-ai-agent/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Cloud or self-hosted: which n8n to pick","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"n8n's own comparison says self-hosting needs technical expertise for installation and configuration, and it recommends n8n Cloud to people who do not have that expertise. If you are comfortable typing a command in a terminal, the free edition is enough for this guide. If you register your email in the free edition, n8n unlocks a few extras: folders, debug in editor and custom execution data.","sources":[{"name":"n8n Docs: Choose your n8n","url":"https://docs.n8n.io/choose-n8n/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"One more cost to know about: the AI model is billed separately from n8n. A tutorial from Techsy notes that the self-hosted Community edition has no execution limits, but any OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini usage is charged by that provider. The Gemini key in this guide is free to create, which makes it the cheapest way to start.","sources":[{"name":"Techsy: n8n AI agents tutorial","url":"https://techsy.io/blog/n8n-ai-agents-tutorial"},{"name":"n8n: Build your first AI agent (template)","url":"https://n8n.io/workflows/6270-build-your-first-ai-agent/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Step by step: your first n8n AI agent","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Install and start n8n","text":"Install Node.js, version 20.19 to 24.x according to n8n's docs. Then open a terminal and run npx n8n to try it without installing anything, or npm install n8n -g followed by n8n start to keep it. Open http://localhost:5678 in your browser. n8n's docs say npm installs are deprecated starting with n8n 3.0, so if you plan to keep using it, the Docker route is the safer long-term setup.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Or start it with Docker","text":"With Docker Desktop installed, create a volume with docker volume create n8n_data, then run the n8nio/n8n image with port 5678 open and that volume mounted to /home/node/.n8n, as the install page shows. Set GENERIC_TIMEZONE to your time zone so scheduled workflows run at the right hour. n8n's docs now point to Docker Compose as the recommended method for a lasting setup.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Get a free Google AI API key","text":"Go to aistudio.google.com/app/apikey, click Create API key in new project and copy the key. n8n's starter template says this free key is the only thing you need to bring.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Load the starter agent and add the key","text":"Open the Build your first AI agent template from n8n's template library. On the canvas, open the node named Connect your model (Google Gemini), choose Create New Credential in the Credential dropdown, paste the key into the API Key field and click Save. The template already wires a Chat Trigger to an AI Agent node, plus a Simple Memory node for follow-up questions and two tools: Get Weather and Get News, which reads an RSS feed.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Open the chat and test it","text":"Go to the Example Chat node and click Open Chat in its panel. Ask for the weather in Paris, then ask for the latest tech news. A weather answer shows the Get Weather tool works; a list of headlines shows Get News works. Ask a follow-up question about the same city to check that memory is doing its job.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Build it yourself instead of using the template","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"n8n's blog walks through the same pieces by hand. Click the plus button on an empty canvas and add a Chat Trigger. Add an AI Agent node and connect the trigger to it. In the agent, choose Connected Chat Trigger Node as the source of the user message. Add a chat model node, such as Google Gemini, OpenAI or Anthropic, create its credential and connect it to the agent's Chat Model input. Tools go into the agent's Tool input.","sources":[{"name":"n8n Blog: How to build your first AI agent","url":"https://blog.n8n.io/how-to-build-ai-agent/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The agent's behavior lives in the System Message, under Options in the AI Agent node. n8n's guide suggests stating the task, explaining when and how to use each tool, and adding constraints. Rename each tool node so its name matches the name you use in the System Message.","sources":[{"name":"n8n Blog: How to build your first AI agent","url":"https://blog.n8n.io/how-to-build-ai-agent/"}]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt 1: A starter System Message","text":"You are a research assistant.
When the user asks about the weather, call the [weather tool name] tool.
When the user asks for news, call the [news tool name] tool and return the 3 most relevant headlines with one line each.
If no tool fits the question, say you cannot check that. Never guess.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"After every test, open the execution in n8n and look at the AI Agent node's input and output. n8n's guide recommends this to see which tools the agent actually called. If it skipped a tool, the fix is usually a clearer System Message or a better description on the tool.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Where n8n agents struggle","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The Techsy tutorial reports that agents get confused once they have more than about five to seven tools, that they can fail without an obvious error, and that n8n gives less control over agent design than code frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI.","sources":[{"name":"Techsy: n8n AI agents tutorial","url":"https://techsy.io/blog/n8n-ai-agents-tutorial"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"n8n is a workflow tool first, and it shows. The practical answer is the same as with any agent: one narrow job, a few tools, and a test run before you trust it with anything real.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Keep your first agent read-only. Weather, news and summaries cannot do damage. Add tools that send email or write to a database only after you have watched a few executions and the agent calls the right tool every time.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Anthropic just launched its own Excel rival, and Microsoft stock dropped the same day
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: On November 10, Anthropic launched Claude Sheets in beta: a spreadsheet built right into Claude. Claude adds tabs, formulas, formatting and charts, and edits cells next to you. It shows every change it makes. Paid plans, beta. Exports to Excel. Claude Meetings puts Claude in video calls as a visible participant. It drafts the plan, answers in the chat and pulls numbers from work apps. It starts on Google Meet for Team and Enterprise plans. Sources: TechCrunch, Engadget, Yahoo Finance, Investing.com via Yahoo Finance, Claude Help Center.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella with a serious expression.

item.nf:article: {"headline":"Anthropic launches Claude Sheets, Meetings and Whiteboards as Microsoft shares slip","dek":"The new beta tools put a spreadsheet, a meeting agent and a shared whiteboard inside Claude, days before the company's planned IPO.","summary":"Anthropic introduced Claude Sheets, Claude Meetings and Claude Whiteboards on November 10, 2026, and renamed Claude Dashboards to Claude Data. Microsoft shares fell about 2% after the news.","seo_title":"Anthropic launches Claude Sheets, Meetings and Whiteboards","seo_description":"Anthropic added a spreadsheet, a video call agent, shared whiteboards and Claude Data to Claude. Microsoft stock fell about 2% on the news.","answer_summary":"Claude Sheets is a beta spreadsheet built into Claude for paid plans. Anthropic launched it on November 10, 2026, together with Claude Meetings, Claude Whiteboards and Claude Data.","tags":["Anthropic","Claude","Claude Sheets","Microsoft","Office software"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Anthropic introduced a set of workplace tools on November 10, 2026, including Claude Sheets, Claude Meetings and Claude Whiteboards, according to TechCrunch and Engadget. The company also renamed its Claude Dashboards product to Claude Data and expanded how outside apps can run inside Claude.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-launches-claude-meetings-to-turn-workplace-discussions-into-plans-and-tasks/"},{"name":"Engadget","url":"https://www.engadget.com/2312177/anthropic-takes-on-google-and-microsoft-with-claude-sheets/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Microsoft shares fell about 2% on Tuesday after reports of the launch, Yahoo Finance and Investing.com reported. Investing.com said the move followed a Bloomberg report that Anthropic planned a spreadsheet app that competes with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/anthropic-launches-meetings-whiteboards-sheets-data-ahead-of-ipo-190548601.html"},{"name":"Investing.com via Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/microsoft-stock-falls-anthropic-takes-180433197.html"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Claude Sheets does","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Claude Sheets is a spreadsheet built into Claude in which a user and Claude edit the same cells. According to Anthropic's help center, Claude can create tabs, write formulas, apply formatting and conditional formatting, and add dropdowns, checkboxes and charts. Formulas stay visible in the cells, and sheets are saved in the Artifacts tab.","sources":[{"name":"Claude Help Center","url":"https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18324300-get-started-with-claude-sheets"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The help center lists the product as a beta for Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise plans. It is on by default for Team plans, while Enterprise administrators must switch it on. Each sheet can hold up to 100,000 cells. Users can import CSV, Excel or Google Sheets files and export to .xlsx or CSV.","sources":[{"name":"Claude Help Center","url":"https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18324300-get-started-with-claude-sheets"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Anthropic also lists clear gaps. Pivot tables, find and replace, filter views and PDF export are not yet available, and macros, VBA and Power Query are not supported. Engadget reported that several people with edit access can work on one file and that Claude's changes are logged so coworkers can follow them.","sources":[{"name":"Engadget","url":"https://www.engadget.com/2312177/anthropic-takes-on-google-and-microsoft-with-claude-sheets/"},{"name":"Claude Help Center","url":"https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18324300-get-started-with-claude-sheets"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"According to Investing.com, Anthropic product leader Nicholas Lin told Bloomberg that Claude Sheets is still a basic product that is not designed for sophisticated financial modeling, and that the company expects its integrations with existing spreadsheet software to remain better for those tasks.","sources":[{"name":"Investing.com via Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/microsoft-stock-falls-anthropic-takes-180433197.html"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Meetings, Whiteboards and Data","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Claude Meetings adds Claude to a video call as a visible participant. TechCrunch reported that during a call it can draft the plan being discussed, map a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat and pull information from connected work apps. Notes and action items are available in claude.ai afterward.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-launches-claude-meetings-to-turn-workplace-discussions-into-plans-and-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Meetings is in beta for Team and Enterprise plans and works only with Google Meet at launch. Claude posts a notice in the chat, will not join calls with outside guests unless an administrator allows it, and leaves if an outside guest joins, according to TechCrunch and Engadget.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-launches-claude-meetings-to-turn-workplace-discussions-into-plans-and-tasks/"},{"name":"Engadget","url":"https://www.engadget.com/2312177/anthropic-takes-on-google-and-microsoft-with-claude-sheets/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Claude Whiteboards, also in beta for paid plans, turns a team's planning discussion into a shared board with timelines and deadlines, and a finished board can be converted into a document or slide deck, TechCrunch reported. Claude Data connects to systems such as a data warehouse or CRM and answers questions with dashboards, written data stories or narrated videos.","sources":[{"name":"TechCrunch","url":"https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-launches-claude-meetings-to-turn-workplace-discussions-into-plans-and-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Engadget reported that Anthropic is also letting users open full versions of partner apps inside Claude, starting with Adobe, Atlassian and HubSpot, and that Claude already offers more than 9,000 connectors.","sources":[{"name":"Engadget","url":"https://www.engadget.com/2312177/anthropic-takes-on-google-and-microsoft-with-claude-sheets/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"The IPO backdrop","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The launch comes as Anthropic begins the roadshow for its initial public offering, which Yahoo Finance said is expected on November 19 or November 20. Investing.com noted that Microsoft is among the companies taking part in a separate $26 billion private placement tied to the offering.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/anthropic-launches-meetings-whiteboards-sheets-data-ahead-of-ipo-190548601.html"},{"name":"Investing.com via Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/microsoft-stock-falls-anthropic-takes-180433197.html"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The products move Anthropic from offering an assistant that works alongside other companies' software toward offering its own versions of everyday office apps. The company's own description of Sheets as basic suggests the near term goal is quick team tasks such as trackers and budgets rather than replacing heavy Excel work, but the market reaction shows investors are watching any overlap with Microsoft 365 closely.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"Watch whether Claude Meetings expands beyond Google Meet to Zoom or Microsoft Teams, and how quickly Sheets fills gaps such as pivot tables, since those steps would bring it closer to competing with Excel directly.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: How to use CapCut AI: captions, scripts and clips in minutes
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: On desktop: import your video, open the Text tab, click Auto captions, pick the language and click Create. The captions land on the timeline, ready to edit. Read every line. Accents, noise and names trip the AI up. On the web, the Styles tab has looks like Glow, or let Style captions with AI pick one. Sources: CapCut: How to add subtitles in CapCut, CapCut: AI Clip Maker, CapCut: Script to video maker, CapCut Help Center: Standard vs Pro, CapCut Help Center: new subscription pricing, Descript.
