item.nf:article: {"kind":"guide","headline":"How to use CapCut AI: auto captions, AI video maker and clipper","dek":"Step by step instructions for the three CapCut AI tools people use most, and what each one needs from your plan.","summary":"CapCut's AI tools can add captions to a video, turn a script into a first draft and cut a long video into short clips. CapCut's help center lists auto captions among the Pro plan's AI tools, so check your plan before you start.","seo_title":"How to use CapCut AI: captions, video maker and clipper","seo_description":"How to use CapCut AI step by step: auto captions on desktop, web and phone, script to video, the AI Clip Maker for shorts, and what needs Pro.","answer_summary":"To use CapCut AI captions on desktop, import a video, open the Text tab, click Auto captions, pick the language and click Create. Script to video and the AI Clip Maker work from CapCut's tools pages, and CapCut lists auto captions as a Pro feature.","tags":["CapCut","AI video","Auto captions","Guides"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"If you want to know how to use CapCut AI, start with three tools. Auto captions writes subtitles from the speech in your video. Script to video writes a script from your idea and builds a first draft from stock footage. The AI Clip Maker finds the best moments in a long video and cuts them into short vertical clips. All three come from CapCut's own instructions below.","sources":[{"name":"CapCut: How to add subtitles in CapCut","url":"https://www.capcut.com/resource/how-to-add-subtitle-in-capcut"},{"name":"CapCut: AI Clip Maker","url":"https://capcut.com/tools/long-video-to-shorts"},{"name":"CapCut: Script to video maker","url":"https://www.capcut.com/tools/script-to-video-maker"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"One thing first: money. CapCut's help center lists auto captions, AI avatars and AI generated content among the advanced AI tools of its Pro plan, while the cheaper Standard plan gets basics like noise reduction. Descript, which sells a competing editor, reports that CapCut moved auto captions behind a paid tier in a 2025 pricing change. CapCut says Pro now comes with 1,200 AI credits and 1TB of cloud storage, and that prices depend on your region and platform, so check the subscription page in the app before you plan around it.","sources":[{"name":"CapCut Help Center: Standard vs Pro","url":"https://www.capcut.com/help/capcut-standard-vs-pro"},{"name":"CapCut Help Center: new subscription pricing","url":"https://www.capcut.com/help/new-capcut-subscription-pricing"},{"name":"Descript","url":"https://descript.com/blog/article/capcut-captions-arent-free-anymore-heres-a-better-option"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to add auto captions in CapCut","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. On desktop: import your video","text":"Open CapCut on your computer and start a new project. In the left sidebar, open the Import tab under Media and click Import, or drag your video into the workspace.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Create the captions","text":"Open the Text tab at the top and click Auto captions. In the pop up, choose the language spoken in the video and click Create. The captions appear on the timeline as separate text clips.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Edit and style them","text":"Use the right sidebar. Captions is where you fix the words. Text, Animation and Tracking control the font, size, layout and movement. When you are happy, click Export in the top right corner, set resolution, frame rate and format, and click Export again.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. On the web: use AI captions","text":"On the CapCut web start page, find the You may want to try section and click AI captions. Upload a video from your computer or your CapCut cloud space. CapCut says the video has to be shorter than 20 minutes. The text shows up in the Subtitles tab, where you can edit, delete or add lines. The Styles tab has looks such as Glow, Trending and Aesthetic, or you can click Style captions with AI and let it choose. Then click Export, or Edit more to open the full editor.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. On your phone: tap Auto captions","text":"In the mobile app, tap Auto captions on the main screen, pick a video or audio file and tap Add. Choose the language and a template style, then tap Generate. Tap Edit captions to fix the text and change fonts and animations, then tap Done and export or share.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Read every caption before you post. CapCut itself says accents, background noise and specialist words can need manual fixes, and names are the usual casualty. If your language is not offered, you can still type subtitles with the text tools and line them up by hand.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to turn a script into a video","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Open Script to video","text":"Sign in to CapCut and open the Script to video tool in your browser. Click Narration for a voice led script, or Commercial if you are selling a product or service, and describe what the video is about.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Pick a script","text":"The AI writer gives you five scripts. Pick the one closest to what you want.","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt: a short narration idea","text":"A 45 second video for small business owners about three simple ways to answer customer emails faster. Friendly, plain words, one tip per scene, end with a short call to action.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Generate and replace","text":"Click Generate video. CapCut builds a first draft from stock footage. Open it in the multi track editor to swap clips for your own, adjust captions, transitions and the voiceover, and set the shape of the video. Then click Export, name the project, choose resolution, frame rate and format, and download it.","sources":[]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"Be realistic about this one. A draft made of stock footage looks like a draft made of stock footage. It is a fast way to get timing and structure, and a poor way to get something that feels like yours. Replace at least the opening shots with your own material.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to cut a long video into shorts with the AI Clip Maker","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Upload the long video","text":"Upload from your computer, CapCut cloud, Google Drive or Dropbox, and keep the page open until the upload finishes. CapCut suggests the tool for video podcasts, lessons, commentary and speeches, where people talk on camera.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Let it find the highlights","text":"The AI Clip Maker picks the strongest moments and cuts them into short clips. CapCut says it can also crop a wide 16:9 video to vertical 9:16 while tracking the speaker, and add captions. Before you export, you can change clip length and apply templates.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Check, edit, export","text":"Click Preview to watch each clip. Click Edit more to trim or fix one in the editor. Click Export to save it or share it straight to social media.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"The AI picks moments from speech, so a clip can start mid thought or end before the punchline. Watch the first and last three seconds of every clip and trim by hand. Those six seconds decide whether anyone keeps watching.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What CapCut AI is good at, and what it is not","sources":[]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"CapCut AI is good at the boring parts of short video: getting words on screen, finding the clip worth posting and turning a wide video into a vertical one. It is weaker at judgment. It does not know which name it misheard, which joke landed or whether stock footage fits your brand. Use it to get to a first version fast, then spend your own time on the opening seconds and the captions, because that is where viewers decide.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Anthropic tells investors its AI hit its own safety threshold
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Anthropic's updated IPO filing on November 10 says: "We made a determination that we have met this threshold." The threshold is a line in its own safety rules for AI that speeds up AI research. Trading could start as soon as November 19. The line is crossed when AI helps pack about two years of progress into a single year. Outside testers at METR estimate Anthropic's models have improved about 1.9 times as fast since October 2025. Sources: Yahoo Finance, Cautious Optimism, CellCog.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Portrait of Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei with a serious expression.

item.nf:article: {"headline":"Anthropic tells investors it has met its own AI research acceleration threshold","dek":"An amended IPO filing dated November 10, 2026 says the company determined its Responsible Scaling Policy line for AI-driven research progress has been met.","summary":"Anthropic's second amended IPO prospectus says the company has determined that it met the threshold in its Responsible Scaling Policy for dramatically accelerated AI progress. The threshold describes roughly two years of progress, at the 2018 to 2024 pace, happening in one year.","seo_title":"Anthropic says it met its AI R&D acceleration threshold","seo_description":"Anthropic's amended IPO filing says it met its Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for AI-driven research acceleration. What the filing says.","answer_summary":"Anthropic's November 10, 2026 amended prospectus says the company determined it has met the Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for AI that dramatically accelerates AI progress. The company said the call rests on expected future models and its overall rate of progress, and that it means added safeguards rather than a halt.","tags":["Anthropic","Claude","AI safety","Responsible Scaling Policy","Anthropic IPO","METR"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Anthropic has told prospective investors that it has met one of the key thresholds in its own safety framework. In the second amendment to its IPO prospectus, dated November 10, 2026, the company wrote that it made a determination that it has met the threshold for dramatically accelerated AI progress, according to Yahoo Finance and to Alex Wilhelm's Cautious Optimism newsletter.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-says-a-key-ai-safety-alarm-has-been-triggered-days-before-its-ipo-171519615.html"},{"name":"Cautious Optimism","url":"https://www.cautiousoptimism.news/tracking-anthropics-acceleration"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The determination rests on what Anthropic expects from future models and on its overall rate of progress, not on an observed capability of a current model, both outlets reported. Yahoo Finance noted that crossing the line triggers more safeguards rather than a shutdown, and that Anthropic said it is still weighing what the result means.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-says-a-key-ai-safety-alarm-has-been-triggered-days-before-its-ipo-171519615.html"},{"name":"Cautious Optimism","url":"https://www.cautiousoptimism.news/tracking-anthropics-acceleration"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What the threshold measures","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy sets out capability levels that require stronger protections. One of them concerns automated AI research. As quoted by Cautious Optimism, it is met if Anthropic determines that its models could fully substitute for its research scientists and engineers at competitive cost, or that AI progress has sharply accelerated in a way likely tied to automating AI research. Yahoo Finance and CellCog describe that acceleration as roughly two years of progress, at the 2018 to 2024 pace, compressed into one year.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-says-a-key-ai-safety-alarm-has-been-triggered-days-before-its-ipo-171519615.html"},{"name":"Cautious Optimism","url":"https://www.cautiousoptimism.news/tracking-anthropics-acceleration"},{"name":"CellCog","url":"https://cellcog.ai/blog/anthropic-s1a-ai-acceleration/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Outside evidence points the same way. Yahoo Finance reported that METR, an independent AI testing nonprofit, estimated Anthropic's models have improved about 1.9 times as fast since October 2025 as before. A separate METR review called Anthropic's August argument that it remained below the threshold overstated and said a crossing was plausible by mid-July.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-says-a-key-ai-safety-alarm-has-been-triggered-days-before-its-ipo-171519615.html"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How the wording changed across three filings","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The language moved quickly. Cautious Optimism reported that the original S-1 of October 26 warned that Anthropic might not identify a significant acceleration until after it had happened. The first amendment, filed November 2, said its estimates suggested it may imminently meet the threshold and stated that no current model had been designated as exceeding it. The second amendment, eight days later, dropped that sentence and said the threshold had been met, according to CellCog's comparison of the documents.","sources":[{"name":"Cautious Optimism","url":"https://www.cautiousoptimism.news/tracking-anthropics-acceleration"},{"name":"CellCog","url":"https://cellcog.ai/blog/anthropic-s1a-ai-acceleration/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The newer filing also adds context on control. Yahoo Finance reported that Anthropic said it does not expect to safely use Claude to fully autonomously design and build later generations of frontier models without meaningful human oversight, and that it is weighing policy changes to keep humans in control. The filing also warns that as Claude speeds up work inside the company, Anthropic may lose visibility into some processes in ways that are hard for people to understand and control.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-says-a-key-ai-safety-alarm-has-been-triggered-days-before-its-ipo-171519615.html"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The disclosure arrives days before the listing. Yahoo Finance reported a price range of $70 to $78 per share, which values the company at up to about $1.4 trillion on a fully diluted basis, with trading possible as soon as November 19. Nvidia and Google are each buying $10 billion of stock at the IPO price as part of a $26 billion private placement, the outlet said.","sources":[{"name":"Yahoo Finance","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/anthropic-says-a-key-ai-safety-alarm-has-been-triggered-days-before-its-ipo-171519615.html"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The filing turns a safety framework that used to be discussed mainly in policy circles into a disclosure that public market investors will read. It is also a rare case of an AI developer stating in a legal document, rather than in a blog post or interview, that its own systems are speeding up its research. Because the determination rests on expectations about future models, the concrete safeguards Anthropic adopts in response will say more about its practical meaning than the threshold itself.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"Anthropic has said it will publish further reports on the implications. The next signal is whether those reports, or later prospectus changes before trading begins, spell out specific new safeguards such as human approval of research decisions.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Google just released its strongest AI yet. It found hidden security holes in under 2 hours
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: On November 10, Google opened Gemini 4 Carbon to the public. It calls it its strongest model for cybersecurity and long, multi-step work. It sits above Gemini 4 Argon and is meant for the hardest jobs, like complex debugging. Google says security firm Wiz used Carbon to scan two major software providers. It found unknown 0-day flaws in under two hours, work Google says normally takes weeks. For two weeks before launch, only selected security defenders had it. Sources: Google, 9to5Google, Digital Trends, Runtime Wire.

nf:hero.nf:alt: Google just released its strongest AI yet. It found hidden security holes in under 2 hours

item.nf:article: {"headline":"Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers and AI Ultra subscribers","dek":"The model, which Google calls its strongest for cybersecurity and long agentic work, launches at an introductory API price that runs through November 30.","summary":"Google opened Gemini 4 Carbon to paying developers, businesses and Google AI Ultra subscribers on November 10, 2026, after two weeks of limited access for cybersecurity defenders. Introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through November 30.","seo_title":"Google Gemini 4 Carbon now available: access, price, uses","seo_description":"Gemini 4 Carbon is out for AI Ultra subscribers and paying developers. Who gets it, what it costs before and after November 30, and what Google claims.","answer_summary":"Gemini 4 Carbon is available from November 10, 2026 to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity, and to paying developers through the Gemini API at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until November 30.","tags":["Google","Gemini","Gemini 4 Carbon","AI models","Cybersecurity"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Google made Gemini 4 Carbon broadly available on November 10, 2026, opening the model to paying developers, businesses, scientists and subscribers to its Google AI Ultra plan. In a post for developers, the company described Carbon as its strongest model, with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities, built for sustained agentic workflows.","sources":[{"name":"Google","url":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-4-carbon-developers/"},{"name":"Digital Trends","url":"https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available-for-complex-ai-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The release ends a period of about two weeks in which Carbon was limited to a small group of cybersecurity defenders through Google DeepMind's Fairwind Program, according to Digital Trends and Runtime Wire. Runtime Wire reported that Koray Kavukcuoglu, Google DeepMind's senior vice president and Google's chief AI architect, announced the wider release.","sources":[{"name":"Digital Trends","url":"https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available-for-complex-ai-tasks/"},{"name":"Runtime Wire","url":"https://runtimewire.com/article/google-gemini-4-carbon-now-available"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Where Carbon fits next to Argon","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Carbon sits above Gemini 4 Argon in Google's lineup. According to 9to5Google, Google describes Argon as the right choice for most software engineering and knowledge work, while Carbon is meant for tasks that test the limits of a model, such as complex multi-step coding and debugging and open-ended scientific research. Argon remains available to AI Pro subscribers and higher tiers.","sources":[{"name":"9to5Google","url":"https://9to5google.com/2026/11/10/gemini-app-4-carbon/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Digital Trends reported that Carbon uses more tokens than Argon and spends that extra effort exploring options and checking its own answers. Google's developer post points to multi-step work in software engineering, full-stack web development and scientific research as the main targets, and says the model has stronger alignment and more reliable follow-through.","sources":[{"name":"Google","url":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-4-carbon-developers/"},{"name":"Digital Trends","url":"https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available-for-complex-ai-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Google claims the model can do","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"In its announcement, as summarized by Digital Trends, Google said Carbon ranked first on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR and Zapier's AutomationBench, and that its cost per task was less than half that of the next best model from another company. Google did not name that rival model or publish absolute cost figures in the announcement Digital Trends described.","sources":[{"name":"Digital Trends","url":"https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available-for-complex-ai-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Google also cited customer examples. Security firm Wiz used Carbon to scan two major software-as-a-service providers and found previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities in under two hours, work Google said would normally take weeks. Axiom Bio used the model to identify toxicity mechanisms its team had not found before and is moving production scientific analyses to Carbon and Argon, according to the same report.","sources":[{"name":"Digital Trends","url":"https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available-for-complex-ai-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Developers also get an early look at a feature called /swarm in Google Antigravity, in which Carbon handles design, coordination and review while lighter, faster models work on other tasks in parallel, Digital Trends reported.","sources":[{"name":"Digital Trends","url":"https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/google-gemini-4-carbon-is-now-available-for-complex-ai-tasks/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Who can use it and what it costs","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Google AI Ultra subscribers can use Carbon in the Gemini app, in AI Mode in Search and in Google Antigravity, with the app rollout starting on November 10, according to 9to5Google. Developers can reach it through the paid tier of the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, and businesses through Gemini for business. Scientists can apply for six months of free access to Argon and Carbon, and cybersecurity defenders can apply to the Fairwind Program.","sources":[{"name":"Google","url":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-4-carbon-developers/"},{"name":"9to5Google","url":"https://9to5google.com/2026/11/10/gemini-app-4-carbon/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through November 30, according to 9to5Google and Runtime Wire. 9to5Google reported that the price then rises to $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens.","sources":[{"name":"9to5Google","url":"https://9to5google.com/2026/11/10/gemini-app-4-carbon/"},{"name":"Runtime Wire","url":"https://runtimewire.com/article/google-gemini-4-carbon-now-available"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The launch puts the security claims at the center of the pitch. The benchmark rankings and the Wiz and Axiom Bio results come from Google and its partners, not from independent testing, so outside evaluations over the coming weeks will show how much of the advantage holds up. The short introductory window also gives developers a cheap period to compare Carbon with Argon and with rival models before the price doubles.","sources":[]},{"kind":"why_it_matters","text":"The next signal to watch is independent benchmark results and developer reports on whether Carbon's higher token use still delivers a lower cost per task once the price rises on December 1.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: How to use DeepSeek safely: the settings to change and what never to type
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: DeepSeek's privacy policy says it stores what it collects on servers in China. That includes your prompts, uploaded files and chat history. Type nothing you would not want stored there. On the web, open Settings, then Data, and switch off the option to improve the model for everyone. In the app, Kaspersky found the same switch under Settings, then Data controls. Sources: DeepSeek Privacy Policy, DeepSeek API Docs: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release, Kaspersky, DeleteMe, The Hacker News, Wikipedia: DeepSeek (chatbot).
item.category: DeepSeek API Docs: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release

nf:hero.nf:alt: How to use DeepSeek safely: the settings to change and what never to type

item.nf:article:
{"kind":"guide","headline":"How to use DeepSeek safely: settings to change and what to keep private","dek":"DeepSeek is free and capable, and its privacy policy says your chats are stored in China. Here is how to use it with less risk, step by step.","summary":"DeepSeek's web chat and apps are free, and the company's privacy policy says prompts, files and chat history are stored on servers in China and may be used to train its models. You can switch off training on your chats, delete shared links and chats, and keep personal details out of what you type.","seo_title":"How to use DeepSeek safely: privacy settings, step by step","seo_description":"How to use DeepSeek safely: turn off model training, delete shared links and chats, delete your account, and what never to type into it.","answer_summary":"Use DeepSeek for general questions only, never for personal, financial or work secrets. On the web, open Settings, then Data, switch off the option to improve the model for everyone, delete shared links you do not need and clear old chats.","tags":["DeepSeek","AI privacy","AI guides","Chatbots"],"paragraphs":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Learning how to use DeepSeek safely starts with one line in its privacy policy: the company says it stores the information it collects on secure servers located in the People's Republic of China. That covers what you type, the files you upload, your feedback and your chat history, plus account details and device information such as your IP address and device model.","sources":[{"name":"DeepSeek Privacy Policy","url":"https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy-2025-02-14.html"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The upside is real. The DeepSeek chatbot is free on the web and in its iOS and Android apps, and the company released its V4 models on April 24, 2026, with a context window of one million tokens that it says is now the default across its official services. So the goal here is not to scare you off. It is to set up DeepSeek so you share as little as possible, and to know what never to type into it.","sources":[{"name":"DeepSeek API Docs: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release","url":"https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news260424/"},{"name":"Wikipedia: DeepSeek (chatbot)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot)"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What DeepSeek does with your data","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The privacy policy lists training and improving DeepSeek's technology, including its machine learning models, among the uses of the information it collects. Account data, including your inputs, is kept while your account is active, and the policy says some information can be kept longer to meet legal obligations or legitimate business interests.","sources":[{"name":"DeepSeek Privacy Policy","url":"https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy-2025-02-14.html"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Kaspersky adds two points worth knowing. As a company based in China, DeepSeek may be required to hand data to Chinese authorities. And because chats can end up in training data, Kaspersky warns that a model can sometimes repeat training data to other users, which is why it advises keeping sensitive information out entirely.","sources":[{"name":"Kaspersky","url":"https://www.kaspersky.com/blog/deepseek-privacy-and-security/54643/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Governments have reacted. On October 20, 2026, the Federal Register published a Department of Homeland Security order that tells federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products from their systems and stop buying them, including third party products developed using DeepSeek. According to The Hacker News, the order does not restrict companies or the public. Earlier, Italy's data protection authority ordered DeepSeek blocked in January 2025, and Australia, Canada and South Korea barred it from government devices.","sources":[{"name":"The Hacker News","url":"https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/us-orders-deepseek-removed-from-federal.html"},{"name":"Wikipedia: DeepSeek (chatbot)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot)"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to use DeepSeek safely: the settings to change","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Sign up with email, not a social login","text":"Kaspersky recommends creating your account with an email address and a strong password you use nowhere else, rather than signing in with Google. At the time of its review, DeepSeek offered no two factor authentication or passkeys, so the password is your only lock.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Turn off training on your chats","text":"On the web, sign in at chat.deepseek.com, open the sidebar, click the three dots next to your name and choose Settings. Open Data and switch off the option to improve the model for everyone. Kaspersky found the same switch in the mobile app under Settings, then Data controls. This only covers future chats: Kaspersky says data already used for training needs an email to privacy@deepseek.com.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Delete shared links you do not need","text":"Anyone who has a shared chat link can read that chat. In Settings, open Data and click Manage next to Shared links. Click the bin icon next to each link you want gone and confirm with Delete.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Clear old chats","text":"To remove one chat, hover over it in the sidebar, click its three dots and choose Delete. To remove everything, go to Settings, then Data, and click Delete all next to Delete all chats. Kaspersky notes that this removes chats from your account, not necessarily from DeepSeek's servers.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Export, then delete the account if you are done","text":"If you want a copy first, use Settings, then Data, then Export. DeleteMe says the download link expires after seven days, and Kaspersky says JSON exports are available only on the web. Then open Settings, then Profile, click Delete next to Delete account, type DELETE MY ACCOUNT and confirm. DeepSeek's policy says a deleted account cannot be reactivated or recovered.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What never to type into DeepSeek","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Treat every message as something stored on a server you do not control. Keep out passwords and login codes, ID and account numbers, health details, client or employer documents, private photos, and anything about other people that they did not agree to share.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"If your job involves a government agency or a federal contract, check your employer's rules before you open DeepSeek on a work device. The DHS order covers federal civilian agencies and, through a contract clause, the contractors working for them.","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"DeepSeek works best for tasks where nothing is private: explaining a concept, drafting a generic email, checking code that contains no secrets, or summarizing a public article. When you need help with something personal, remove the identifying details first. The prompt below lets you keep the structure of a text while the real names and numbers stay with you.","sources":[{"name":"Kaspersky","url":"https://www.kaspersky.com/blog/deepseek-privacy-and-security/54643/"}]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt: rewrite a text with the private details removed","text":"The text below uses placeholders like [NAME], [COMPANY], [CITY] and [AMOUNT] instead of real details.
Keep every placeholder exactly as it is, in the same place.
Rewrite the text so it is clear, polite and under 150 words.

Text:
[paste your text with placeholders here]","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Once you get the answer back, swap the real names and numbers in yourself. It takes a minute, and the private part never leaves your computer.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"The most private option: run DeepSeek on your own computer","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"DeepSeek publishes the weights of its models under the MIT License, while the web and mobile apps are proprietary. That means you can run a version of the model locally, where your chats never reach the company's servers. Kaspersky suggests LM Studio, which works offline, and says smaller models in the 7B to 13B range suit a laptop with 16 to 32 GB of RAM. The trade off, according to Kaspersky: a local model cannot look up current information online.","sources":[{"name":"Kaspersky","url":"https://www.kaspersky.com/blog/deepseek-privacy-and-security/54643/"},{"name":"Wikipedia: DeepSeek (chatbot)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot)"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Running it locally does not remove every issue. Reports collected on Wikipedia's DeepSeek page say locally hosted versions still sometimes give answers consistent with Chinese Communist Party narratives, and the hosted chatbot limits answers on topics such as the Tiananmen Square massacre and Taiwan's political status.","sources":[{"name":"Wikipedia: DeepSeek (chatbot)","url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepSeek_(chatbot)"}]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"DeepSeek is a strong free model, and for public, low stakes questions it does the job. The problem is not the quality of the answers but where the conversation lives afterward. Switch off training, clear your shared links, keep personal and work details out, and use a local model or a different assistant when the subject is private.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: How to build your first Zapier AI agent for free, step by step
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: Sign in at agents.zapier.com. Take the tour, or use the + icon in the sidebar and pick New agent. Describe the job in plain English or start from a template. Choose what starts the agent: on demand, on a schedule, from a Zap or from another app. Example: a new lead arrives, the agent sums it up and emails sales. Open Insert tools, then Add tool. Add data sources like Google Drive or Notion, and actions like a Gmail draft. Sources: Zapier: Zapier Agents guide, Zapier Help Center: How is Zapier Agents usage measured?, Zapier Agents pricing, Zapier: Zapier Agents overview, XRAY Tech.

Each one can start on a trigger, read from data sources such as Google Drive or Notion, search the web and run actions in the apps Zapier connects to. Zapier says the product has moved out of beta into general availability, and anyone with a Zapier account can try it for free at agents.zapier.com.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents guide","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents-guide/"},{"name":"Zapier Agents pricing","url":"https://zapier.com/l/agents-pricing"},{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents overview","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"The short version: one agent, one narrow job, a small set of tools, and a test run before you let it work alone. Below is the setup step by step, the limits of the free plan and a starter prompt you can copy.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents guide","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents-guide/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"What Zapier AI agents cost and what counts as an activity","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Zapier measures agent usage in activities, not in the tasks used by regular Zaps. The Free plan includes 400 activities a month with up to 10 per run. Pro includes 1,500 a month with up to 40 per run and costs $33.33 a month billed annually ($400 a year). Enterprise has a custom limit and adds agent sharing across the company.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier Help Center: How is Zapier Agents usage measured?","url":"https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/26559132765325"},{"name":"Zapier Agents pricing","url":"https://zapier.com/l/agents-pricing"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"One activity is one thing the agent does: using a trigger, answering from a knowledge source, running an action, browsing or scraping a page, running a web search, or receiving a message through the Chrome extension. On the Free plan, test runs count toward your 400. On paid plans they do not.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier Help Center: How is Zapier Agents usage measured?","url":"https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/26559132765325"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"When you reach the limit, agents stop running actions, searches, triggers and knowledge lookups until your billing date resets the count, though you can still chat with them. Zapier emails you at 80 percent and again at 100 percent. If one run hits the per-run cap, the agent asks for your input before it continues.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier Help Center: How is Zapier Agents usage measured?","url":"https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/26559132765325"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"How to build your first Zapier agent","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"1. Start a new agent","text":"Go to agents.zapier.com and sign in. If you have no agents yet, click Take a tour, then Create my first agent. If you already have some, hover over the + icon in the left sidebar and click New agent.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"2. Describe the job or pick a template","text":"Write what the agent should do in plain English, or choose one of the ready-made templates on the left. Click Create agent to let the prompt assistant tidy up your instructions, or Skip this step to keep your own wording.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"3. Connect the apps you named","text":"If your instructions mention apps, Zapier asks you to connect those accounts. You can do it now from the dropdowns or skip it and come back later.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"4. Choose a trigger","text":"Pick what starts the agent: on demand, on a set schedule, from a Zap or from another app. Zapier's own example is a new Facebook Lead Ads lead that the agent summarizes and emails to the sales team through Gmail.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"5. Add data sources and actions","text":"Open the Insert tools tab and click Add tool. Choose an app as a data source, for example a Google Sheets file or a Notion page, or choose an action, for example creating a Gmail draft. You can also pick Call an agent to hand part of the work to another agent. Inside the Instructions field, typing a slash lets you insert an action or data.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"6. Test it and save","text":"Run a test in the panel on the right, read what the agent did, adjust the instructions and test again. When it behaves, click Save. Use Share in the top right if a teammate should see or edit it.","sources":[]},{"kind":"step","title":"7. Check the activity log","text":"Click All activity in the left panel to see each run. Anything under Needs action is waiting for you: the agent needs more information, you told it to pause at a decision point, or a connection broke.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"A starter prompt to copy","sources":[]},{"kind":"prompt","title":"Prompt: an inbox triage agent that only drafts","text":"You are my inbox assistant.
When a new email arrives:
1. Label it as urgent, normal or spam.
2. For urgent emails, write a short, polite reply draft in my voice.
3. For spam, do nothing.
Rules: never send an email yourself. Only create drafts. If you are not sure what the sender wants, write "Needs a human" at the top of the draft.","sources":[]},{"kind":"tip","text":"Zapier suggests writing instructions as if for a new team member with no context: give a role, put the steps in order, say how long and in what tone the output should be, and wrap long background in tags like <context>. Showing one example of the output you want also helps.","sources":[]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Examples of Zapier agents worth trying","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Zapier's template library has close to 100 agents. Its examples include lead enrichment that researches a lead, updates the CRM and drafts outreach; customer support that routes tickets using help docs; email management that drafts replies and archives spam; meeting prep that builds agendas in Google Docs; and expense tracking that logs invoices from QuickBooks or Stripe into Google Sheets.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents guide","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents-guide/"},{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents overview","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents/"}]},{"kind":"heading","text":"Where Zapier agents fall short","sources":[]},{"kind":"fact","text":"Zapier itself says to use a regular Zap when you need precision and an agent when roughly 80 percent accuracy is acceptable and speed matters more. It recommends starting with low-stakes tasks, requiring approval before important actions and keeping risky actions, such as deleting data, inside a single agent.","sources":[{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents guide","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents-guide/"},{"name":"Zapier: Zapier Agents overview","url":"https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-agents/"}]},{"kind":"fact","text":"In hands-on testing, XRAY Tech found that fields left for the agent to fill in can change from run to run, and suggested fixing key values, such as the Slack recipient of a message, so the agent cannot choose them. It also found that template actions still need to be configured by hand.","sources":[{"name":"XRAY Tech","url":"https://www.xray.tech/post/ai-agents-zapier"}]},{"kind":"tip","text":"On the Free plan, keep tests short. A test that browses the web and runs three actions can use several of your 400 monthly activities at once.","sources":[]},{"kind":"analysis","text":"The honest pitch for Zapier Agents is a smart helper for repetitive, forgiving work: sorting, summarizing and drafting. Anything that sends, pays or deletes is better left as a draft that a person approves, at least until you have watched the activity log for a while.","sources":[]}]}

item.title: Anthropic just set its real IPO price: about $1 trillion
item.author: NeuraFeed news desk
item.description: On November 10, Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 a share. It is selling 825 million shares, most of them new. Reuters says that raises up to $64.4 billion. Late on November 9, bankers got IPO details that Anthropic quickly took back, Reuters reported. That version said up to $80 a share. The new top price is $78. That is Reuters' math from the filing. Anthropic's last private value was $965 billion. Sources: Reuters, Anthropic, RTTNews, Reuters via Investing.com, Malay Mail (AFP).

nf:hero.nf:alt: Anthropic just set its real IPO price: about $1 trillion
